entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Katihar (Town) P.S. Case No. 826 of 2022,
instituted for the offence under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The complaint case arises out of the dispute which is in the nature a matrimonial dispute between the parties where there is an allegation of mistreatment and assault against the petitioner.
Petitioner is husband of O.P. No.2 4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.39973 of 2023(2)
dt.19-08-2023 petitioner is willing to reconcile the issue with his wife.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner will make all genuine efforts to reconcile the issue so that the reconciliation culminates in restoration of matrimonial harmony or one time settlement as agreed upon between the petitioner and the O.P No.2.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the O.P No.2 does not object to such proposal as long as amicable settlement is reached between the parties.

6. In view of the such submission, since terms of amicable settlement are to be worked out to facilitate the same, the Court directs that, till further orders, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with Katihar (Town) P.S. Case No. 826 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned C.J.M,
Katihar.

7. Let the parties appear before the District Mediation Centre, Katihar on or before 04.09.2023.
8.
Learned Mediator shall submit his report to this Court within three months thereafter.

(Madhuresh Prasad, J) SUMIT/-
